jobs.title: Marketing Automation Specialist (m/f/d | 100%)
jobs.description:
Are you ready to use innovation to improve the lives of millions of people?
Do you think one step ahead, see opportunities where others see limits, and want to invest your energy in something meaningful? If so, INTEGRA is the right place for you.
Our solutions are not created by chance – they are the result of passion, precision and team spirit. With every technology we develop, we help people around the world to research diseases, perform diagnoses and enable new therapies. Whether in diagnostics, research or quality control, our instruments – made in Switzerland and the USA – make laboratory work safer, more efficient and more sustainable.

With us, you can make changes that will shape the world.
Does this sound like what you're looking for? Then join our team and help to accelerate scientific discovery.
What you can expect from the role
This is not a role where you work through other people’s tickets. As our Marketing Automation Specialist, you own Salesforce Account Engagement: you shape its roadmap, decide how it develops and see the impact of your work in our sales pipeline.
• Run and further develop Salesforce Account Engagement as product owner
• Define the roadmap and backlog, and turn requirements into configuration or user stories for Application IT
• Build automated customer journeys and email campaigns with Marketing, Sales and Product Management
• Refine lead scoring and the handover of qualified leads to Sales
• Keep data quality, CRM sync and email deliverability in good shape
• Work closely with our Product Owner Digital Customer Experience
• Measure performance with clear KPIs, reports and dashboards
• Evaluate new Salesforce features, including AI, and help decide the platform’s future
What you offer
• Degree in marketing, business, business informatics or similar, or equivalent experience
• 3+ years of hands-on experience with a B2B marketing automation platform, ideally Salesforce Account Engagement
• Good understanding of Salesforce CRM data and lead management
• Basic HTML/CSS skills for email templates and landing pages
• Experience with requirements, user stories and backlogs
• Analytical, structured and independent, and at ease with several stakeholders
• Fluent English; German is a plus

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei pronto ad innovare per migliorare la vita di milioni di persone?
Pensi un passo avanti, vedi opportunità dove gli altri vedono limiti – e vogliono investire la tua energia in qualcosa di significativo? Allora sei esattamente a INTEGRA.
Le nostre soluzioni non sono create per caso – sono il risultato di passione, precisione e spirito di squadra. Con ogni tecnologia che sviluppiamo, aiutiamo le persone in tutto il mondo a fare malattie di ricerca, fare diagnosi e abilitare nuove terapie. Sia nella diagnostica, nella ricerca o nel controllo della qualità: i nostri strumenti “Made in Switzerland & USA” rendono il lavoro di laboratorio più efficiente, più sicuro e più sostenibile.

Quello che fai con noi muove il mondo.
Sembra quello che stai cercando? Quindi diventare parte del nostro team – e contribuire ad accelerare le scoperte scientifiche.
Cosa puoi fare
• Funzionamento e monitoraggio delle moderne posizioni di automazione e macchine per stampaggio ad iniezione
• Elaborazione dei compiti di produzione in camera pulita
• Eseguire ispezioni finali e/o imballaggi finali
• Lavori di assemblaggio e confezionamento
• Documentazione dei lavori svolti
• Garantire un'alta qualità della pratica
Cosa porti
• L'esperienza nella produzione/assemblaggio è vantaggiosa
• Prontezza per ore di lavoro irregolari (lavoro di spostamento) in camera pulita
• Metodi di lavoro rapidi, efficienti e precisi
• Personalità di squadra
• Buone capacità di comunicazione in tedesco
descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you ready to innovate to improve the lives of millions of people?
You think one step further, see opportunities where others see limits – and want to invest your energy in something meaningful? Then you are exactly right at INTEGRA.

With every technology we develop, we help people around the world research diseases, make diagnoses and enable new therapies. Whether in diagnostics, research or quality control: Our instruments “Made in Switzerland & USA” make laboratory work more efficient, safer and more sustainable.
